ta_read.text: SPY's daily swings show mixed swings (a range); the last structure break was down on Nov 5, when it closed below $750.36. On weekly bars it is in a sideways (between its 10- and 40-week averages), and the weekly swings show lower highs and lower lows.

The nearest support zone is $736.90–$739.75, where price turned 2 times, most recently on Jul 17; the nearest resistance zone is $745.75–$750.55, where price turned 5 times, most recently on Oct 30, a former support that flipped to resistance.
Over the last 25 sessions there were 8 distribution days (down on rising volume) and 2 accumulation days (up on rising volume); the last move (-1.9%) came on heavy volume.
RSI is 40 (neutral), with a bearish divergence on Nov 4: price made a higher high but RSI made a lower one: momentum is not confirming the rise; MACD is below its signal line since Oct 15.
A daily close above $750.55 would clear the nearest resistance and confirm strength; a close below $736.90 would break the nearest support and confirm weakness. Direction is not predicted.

ai_note.subject: SPY
ai_note.text: The committee says Hold, and the chart and fundamentals agree there is no clean trend: the structure is a range, price is below its 50-day average, and the last structure break was down on Nov 5. There were 8 distribution days against 2 accumulation days in the last 25 sessions, RSI is 40, and a bearish divergence suggests momentum was not confirming the earlier rise. The market table shows SPY at 739.95 after a 1.9% drop, which is just above the 736.90 to 739.75 support zone. A close below 736.90 would confirm weakness, while a close above 750.55 would clear resistance and turn the picture supportive. In my opinion the lean is down for now, and the next session is mainly about whether 736.90 holds.
